intelligent-websites.name: Intelligent websites
intelligent-websites.short: Modern websites with chatbot, forms and booking.
intelligent-websites.long: We build professional, responsive websites that handle enquiries, take booking requests and talk to your tools — as soon as the integrations are in place.
intelligent-websites.problem: A classic website is often just a shop window. Visitors rarely get in touch, enquiries get lost and manual replies take time.
intelligent-websites.solution: Fluxia builds websites that answer visitors, qualify leads and prepare bookings — in your three market languages.
intelligent-websites.exampleBody: A regional service provider replaces its contact form with an intelligent page featuring a chatbot and booking request. Fluxia sets up the questions, answers and routing rules.
steps: Design, build and connection to email or CRM
intelligent-websites.limits: Chatbot answers are based on your approved knowledge base. When uncertain, the conversation is handed off to a human.

website-redesign.name: Website redesign
website-redesign.short: Modernisation, mobile, performance, accessibility and SEO.
website-redesign.long: We modernise existing websites: faster loading, clearer offerings, accessibility and a structure that reaches customers and search engines.
website-redesign.problem: Old sites load slowly, are hard to use on mobile and no longer reflect your current offering.
website-redesign.solution: We keep what works and replace what gets in the way. Fresh content, clear structure, modern technology.
website-redesign.exampleBody: A tradesperson modernises their site, adds a photo gallery and a request form with call-back time, visible on mobile.
steps: New design, new content, technical build
website-redesign.limits: Search rankings depend on many factors; we do not guarantee positions, but solid technical foundations.

content-creation.name: Content & video
content-creation.short: Automated creation of copy, social posts and short videos.
content-creation.long: We support your regular content production for your website, newsletter or social channels. Every publication is approved by you.
content-creation.problem: Producing content regularly costs time you don't have in daily operations.
content-creation.solution: Workflows that draft copy, pick visuals and prepare short videos — with human approval before any publication.
content-creation.exampleBody: A restaurant receives weekly draft posts about offers and opening hours; they only need to confirm.
content-creation.limits: No content is published without your approval. We don't invent offers or prices.

ai-agents.name: AI agents & reception
ai-agents.short: Written and voice assistants available around the clock.
ai-agents.long: Chat and voice assistants answer common questions, qualify enquiries and escalate to a human when things get sensitive.
ai-agents.problem: Enquiries come in at night, on weekends or when you're on site. Many prospects don't wait.
ai-agents.solution: An assistant captures the enquiry, answers standard questions and collects the information you need for your callback.
ai-agents.exampleBody: A hotel automatically answers questions about rooms, breakfast and parking, and forwards booking enquiries to reception.
steps: Build the knowledge base and rules
Integrate with the website and optionally the phone
ai-agents.limits: The assistant always identifies as AI. It doesn't quote unconfirmed prices or slots not verified by the booking system.

business-automation.name: Business automation
business-automation.short: Emails, documents, orders, stock and reports — automated.
business-automation.long: We connect your tools and automate repetitive steps — from quote to invoice, from lead to follow-up.
business-automation.problem: Data gets re-keyed, emails are handled manually, reports are pieced together at month-end.
business-automation.solution: Fluxia identifies the bottlenecks and builds automations that make your existing tools talk to each other.
business-automation.exampleBody: A retailer receives a daily consolidated report on orders, stock and returns from their existing systems.
business-automation.limits: Automations depend on your existing tools and their interfaces. Not everything is technically or legally possible.

instant-lead-response.name: Instant lead response
instant-lead-response.short: Acknowledge, qualify and route any new enquiry immediately.
instant-lead-response.long: Every new enquiry gets an immediate acknowledgement. The assistant asks the right questions and passes the qualified enquiry to the right person.
instant-lead-response.problem: Prospects compare providers in minutes. Whoever replies first often wins the job.
instant-lead-response.solution: Automatic acknowledgement, structured follow-up questions and team notifications — 24/7, without promising human availability you can't deliver.
instant-lead-response.limits: The assistant answers only from approved information. Sensitive topics are handed to a human.

document-processing.name: Document processing
document-processing.short: Extract, classify and prepare invoices and delivery notes for review.
document-processing.long: Documents are read automatically, data extracted, checked and prepared for human approval. Payments are never automatic.
document-processing.problem: Manually entering documents costs hours per week and causes errors.
document-processing.solution: Fluxia sets up a processing pipeline: scan or email → extraction → check → approval by your team.
document-processing.limits: No payment is triggered without human approval. Sensitive data is governed by your privacy policy.

follow-up-sequences.name: Follow-up sequences
follow-up-sequences.short: Structured follow-up respecting consent and opt-out.
follow-up-sequences.long: Reminders, personalised follow-ups and CRM steps — with respect for consent and opt-out.
follow-up-sequences.problem: Many quotes go nowhere for lack of follow-up.
follow-up-sequences.solution: A follow-up process that saves time while respecting the legal rules.
follow-up-sequences.limits: Marketing messages are only sent to recipients legally allowed to receive them.

customer-reactivation.name: Customer reactivation
customer-reactivation.short: Segment inactive contacts and — where allowed — reactivate them.
customer-reactivation.long: Analysis of your contact base, segmentation and preparation of tailored campaigns. Only with confirmed legal basis.
customer-reactivation.problem: Many past customers don't return because the contact is lost.
customer-reactivation.solution: We prepare campaigns that fit your data and your goals — respecting privacy.
customer-reactivation.limits: No campaign goes out without your approval and without checking consents.

internal-reporting.name: Internal reporting
internal-reporting.short: Sales, stock, service — clear dashboards from your sources.
internal-reporting.long: Consolidation of your data into simple, reliable reports. Numbers computed deterministically; sources traceable.
internal-reporting.problem: Reports come together at month-end from spreadsheets and memory — error-prone.
internal-reporting.solution: Fluxia connects your sources and delivers up-to-date, comparable overviews.
internal-reporting.limits: Dashboards are only as good as the quality of your source data.

Germany, France and Belgium, plus neighbouring countries on request, including remotely. The contact location is Wuppertal.
Pricing depends on scope and integrations. Please contact us for a tailored quote.
You can request a meeting. It is confirmed only after the booking system or team confirms it.

faqs.a: Yes, it can be configured to handle common questions and escalate complex issues.
Compliance depends on use case. It is not automatic; assessment and validation are required.
